model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the effect of context masking on case tasks grouped by language family. The horizontal axis lists various language families, including IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indo, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, in a categorical scale. The vertical axis represents the effect, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, marked in increments of 10. Each bar corresponds to a specific model, including mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, and XLM-B2, distinguished by different colors. The heights of the bars vary, with the tallest bar for IE-Indo reaching approximately 20 and the shortest bar for Uralic being around 0. The bars are grouped by language family, with error bars indicating the standard deviation for each model. No specific sorting or emphasis is applied to the bars, and they are presented in a straightforward manner.
